title: 第2484章 西圣杀意第2483章 古代强者
content_zh:
黑暗魔龙、斩情圣尊、还有魔罗王，黑暗帝庭走出的三大强者，一个比一个惊人，皆有盖世战力！
“黑暗帝庭，究竟藏了多少强者？”众人心惊，越想越感到后背发凉，这该不会是一场提前准备好的陷阱，就等着他们杀上门来吧？
“黑暗帝庭虽然是在泽天海域一战过后才冒出来的，但却蛰伏了很多年，否则怎能网罗这许多的高手。”萧沉心中暗暗说道，也不知那位帝主，和大帝羲究竟是什么关系。
“胆敢杀来我帝庭，受死吧！”
又一道惊天动地的怒吼声传出，黑暗帝庭内爆射出一道璀璨的银光，紧接着，一尊生长着银色双瞳的绝代强者踏步而出，银辉倾泻，符文环绕，彰显了他的强大无匹。
“银瞳族的强者！”不少人露出异色，那双银瞳太显眼，惹人注目，一看便知来自哪个种族。
“该不会是银瞳族那位盖世无匹的古祖吧？”有人大胆猜测道，引得众人内心剧颤。
银瞳族，在诸天万界数不清的种族里，不算最顶尖的，但因为百万年前诞生了一位绝世强者，引领银瞳族走向了辉煌绝巅，那位强者，便被认为是银瞳族的古祖。
时移世易，百万年过去，所有人都认为银瞳族的古祖已经坐化了，没想到竟然在黑暗帝庭之中！
“银瞳开九天！”那尊银瞳古祖再度大吼，银瞳闪耀极致的辉芒，成片的符文压盖而出，瞬间让大片的虚无空间崩开了，无比恐怖的力量向着来犯的强者杀去！
“我来领教银瞳族前辈的高招！”
南天界主豪迈开口，神箭射杀而出，洞穿虚空，粉碎符文，对抗银瞳古祖的杀招！
“黑暗帝主还未出现，仅是他的手下就挡住了几位绝顶强者！”有圣人感慨。
就在这时，黑暗帝庭的深处，又有圣王人物迈步而出，且不止一尊，而是数尊齐至！
十大圣王，没有一人是借助黑暗力量踏足圣王层次的，这才是黑暗帝庭真正的恐怖之处！
“战！”
第一圣将吼喝虚空，战意凌九霄，恐怖的拳头怒扫而出，如百万年的凶兽挣脱束缚，狂乱的凶气席卷十方，让对面的帝庭强者都感到心颤。
嘭！
一尊又一尊的圣王出手了，粉碎星河，震断天路，黑暗帝庭外的无垠空间瞬间就被打爆了，神光沸腾，诸星湮灭！
这一战，远比泽天海域之战参与的圣王更多，尽管黑暗帝主还未出手，却已撼动了诸天万界！

“乾坤无量掌！”九霄王和另一尊九霄主界的圣王联手攻伐，茫茫无量的乾坤力量爆发，这是一门极其高明的大神通，二人一同施展，威力更强，一下就震退了前方的两尊圣王！
“黄金圣气！”
黄金古族的太上长老也出手了，体内的血液沸腾，仿佛有先祖大帝的大道碎片被提炼出来，而后汇聚到眉心。
紧接着，他的眉心出现一尊神祇，口诵大道真经，施展黄金大道真义，化作一道又一道黄金圣气，劈斩而出，如绝世天刀，锋利无匹，粉碎空间，撕裂万物！
修行到圣王境界，哪个是凡俗？太初神子同样出手了，攻势猛烈，成千上万道太初圣光怒劈而出，压着黑暗帝庭的圣王战斗。
万圣书院也展现出了他们不为人知的底蕴，除了齐天川外，还有一位圣王强者，站在这一境界的第二个小台阶上，只是寿元无多，血气不那么旺盛了。
content_en:
The Dark Demon Dragon, the Love-Slaying Saint, and the Demon King, the three powerful men who came out of the Dark Emperor's Court, each one is more amazing than the other, and they all have unparalleled combat power!
"How many powerful people are hidden in the Dark Emperor's Court?" Everyone was frightened, and the more they thought about it, the more chills ran down their backs. Could this be a trap prepared in advance, just waiting for them to come?
"Although the Dark Imperial Court only emerged after the battle in the Zetian sea area, it has been dormant for many years. Otherwise, how could it have attracted so many masters." Xiao Chen said secretly in his heart, and he did not know what the relationship between that emperor and the Great Emperor Xi was.
"If you dare to come to my imperial court, you will die!"
Another earth-shattering roar came out, and a bright silver light erupted from the Dark Imperial Court. Immediately afterwards, a peerless strong man with silver eyes stepped out. The silver light poured out and was surrounded by runes, demonstrating his unparalleled power.
"A strong man from the silver-eyed tribe!" Many people showed strange expressions. Those silver eyes were so conspicuous and eye-catching that you could tell which race they came from at a glance.
"Could it be the unparalleled ancient ancestor of the Silver Eyes tribe?" Someone boldly guessed, causing everyone to tremble in their hearts.
The Silver Eyes clan is not the top among countless races in the world, but because a peerless strong man was born a million years ago and led the Silver Eyes clan to the pinnacle of glory, that strong man is considered the ancient ancestor of the Silver Eyes clan.
Time has changed, and millions of years have passed. Everyone thought that the ancient ancestor of the Silver Eyes tribe had passed away. Unexpectedly, he was actually in the Dark Imperial Court!
"Silver eyes open for nine days!" The ancient ancestor with silver eyes roared again, his silver eyes shone with extreme brilliance, and patches of runes burst out, instantly causing a large area of ​​void space to collapse, and the incomparable terrifying power rushed towards the invading strong man!
"I'm here to learn the clever tricks from the seniors of the Silver Eyes Clan!"
The Lord of the Nantian Realm spoke boldly, and the divine arrow shot out, piercing the void, shattering the runes, and resisting the killing move of the Silver Eyed Ancestor!
"The Dark Emperor hasn't appeared yet, but his men alone have blocked several extremely powerful men!" A saint lamented.
At this moment, from the depths of the Dark Imperial Court, another figure of the Holy King stepped out, not just one, but several!
None of the ten holy kings have reached the level of holy kings with the help of dark power. This is the real terror of the Dark Emperor Court!
"Fight!"
The first holy general roared in the void, his fighting spirit reached the sky, and his terrifying fists flew out in anger, like a million-year-old beast breaking free from its restraints. The frenzied ferocity swept across the ten directions, making the strong men in the Imperial Court opposite feel trembling.
Bang!
One after another, the Holy Kings took action, shattering the galaxies and breaking the sky. The boundless space outside the Dark Emperor's Court was instantly exploded, the divine light boiled, and the stars were annihilated!
This battle involves far more holy kings than the battle in the Zetian sea area. Even though the Dark Emperor has not yet taken action, it has already shaken the world!
"The Palm of the Infinite Universe!" King Jiuxiao and another holy king from the main realm of Jiuxiao joined forces to attack, and the power of the boundless universe exploded. This was an extremely brilliant magical power. When the two of them used it together, it was even more powerful and knocked back the two holy kings in front!
"Golden Holy Qi!"
The Supreme Elder of the Golden Ancient Clan also took action, and the blood in his body boiled, as if fragments of the great ancestor's great path had been extracted, and then gathered between his eyebrows.
Immediately afterwards, a god appeared between his brows, recited the True Sutra of the Great Dao, displayed the true meaning of the Golden Dao, turned into golden holy energy one after another, and slashed out, like a peerless heavenly sword, with unparalleled sharpness, shattering space and tearing apart everything!
After cultivating to the realm of the Holy King, which one is ordinary? The Supreme Son of God also took action, and the offensive was fierce. Thousands of Supreme Holy Lights burst out angrily, suppressing the battle of the Holy King in the Dark Imperial Court.
All Saints Academy also showed their unknown background. In addition to Qi Tianchuan, there is also a strong Saint King, standing on the second small step of this realm, but his life is short and his vitality is not so strong.
